chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa', who said: Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl narrated to us, from Abu Hamza, who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to me:
Only he who recognizes God truly worships God. As for one who does not recognize God, he is only worshipping Him like this — in error.

I said: 'May I be made a ransom for you, so what is the recognition of God?' He said: 'Ratification of God, Mighty and Majestic, and ratification of His Messenger (may God's blessings be upon him and his family), and allegiance to Ali (peace be upon him), and following him and the Imams of Guidance (peace be upon them), and disavowal before God, Mighty and Majestic, of their enemies. Thus is God, Mighty and Majestic, recognized.'

key_terms.أئمة الهدى: Imams of Guidance — the twelve Imams of the Ahlulbayt
key_terms.الائتمام: Following the Imam, acknowledging his leadership
key_terms.البراءة: Disavowal, dissociation — from enemies of the Imams
key_terms.ضلالاً: In error/astray — worship without proper recognition is spiritually void
key_terms.معرفة الله: Recognition/knowledge of God — in Shia theology, this includes not only belief in God but adherence to the wilaya (authority) of the Imams
key_terms.موالاة: Allegiance, love, loyalty — designating the bond with the Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the recognition of God (ma'rifat Allah) according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Imam al-Baqir (AS) defines true worship as contingent upon true recognition (ma'rifa) of God. He explains that worship without knowledge is mere error. When asked to define this recognition, the Imam presents a comprehensive creedal statement linking it to belief in God, belief in the Prophet, love and allegiance to Imam Ali, following the Imams of Guidance, and dissociation from their enemies. This was addressed to Abu Hamza al-Thumali, a trusted companion, and reflects the Shia theological teaching that correct theology (imamate) is the foundation of valid worship.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa who said, ‘Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl narrated to us, from Abu Hamza who said, 
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘But rather, he worships Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one who recognises Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So, as for the one who does not recognise Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so rather he is worshipping Him<sup>azwj</sup> like this, ‘ضَلَالًا’ (under dark covers of kufr) erroneously’.
I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! So what is the recognition of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Ratification of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and ratification of His Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and the Master of the Command Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and the following with him<sup>asws</sup> and the Imams<sup>asws</sup> of the Guidance, and the disavowing to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from their enemies. Like this, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is recognised’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ who has said that Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl narrated to me from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Only those who know Allah worship Him. Those who do not know Allah they worship Him just like that in misguidance.”

I then asked, may Allah take my soul in service for your cause, what the knowledge about Allah?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Knowledge about Allah means is to acknowledge the existence of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, to acknowledge His messenger and to love Imam Ali (a.s.). Of such knowledge is to follow him and the Imams of guidance and to denounce before Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, their (Imams’) enemies. This is how the knowledge about Allah is.”
